writeup: JOOLA's Perseus Pro V pickleball paddle in Black/Red (SKU 600559, 16mm Blaze Red) is $149.99 new on Woot, with three left and a three-per-customer limit. That puts Woot about 49% below the cheapest live brand/specialty price and saves roughly $150 on a current top-line paddle.
